notes: Corrected: the *with* of *shall abound with blessings* moved from רַב to בְּרָכוֹת. רַב is tagged construct with בְּרָכוֹת as its nomen rectum, so rule 19's recast relational expression belongs to the rectum; the chapter reads the same shape that way at 28.6, 28.18 and 28.25, while its valency assignments (28.7, 28.19, 28.21, 28.23) all stand on absolute participles or verbs with bare objects.
Everything else in the verse was left as accepted.
